description: Update a newsletter audience: its name, description, whether new issues start with a View in browser link, list cleanup settings, or the wording of its confirmation and last-chance emails. Show the user any new email wording before saving it.

cleanup_enabled.description: Turn list cleanup on or off. A cold subscriber gets one last-chance email in place of the next newsletter.

cleanup_ignored_issues.description: Tracked newsletters ignored in a row before a subscriber counts as cold. Default 6.

cleanup_inactive_days.description: Days without a sign of life before a subscriber counts as cold. Default 180.

confirmation_email_copy.description: Replaces the double opt-in confirmation email's wording; null or {} clears it, omit to keep it. A subject and a message per language (en, fr, es). Only those change; the button, links, expiry, unsubscribe link and sender details stay fixed. A language left out, and a reader whose email is in another language, get the built-in email. No links or domain names, email addresses, phone numbers or invisible characters. Adding or changing text needs a paid plan and newsletter sending in good standing.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key. If omitted, the MCP server generates one for POST tools.
